obra/superpowers Shell 1,034 An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works. New approach to agent skill definition.
Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios Shell 353 Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system.
HKUDS/nanobot Python 49,644 Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows.
CopilotKit/CopilotKit TypeScript 38,371 The Frontend Stack for Agents & Generative UI. Makers of the AG-UI Protocol.
esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix Go 35,992 A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks. DeepSeek-powered agentic development.

📦 AI Applications

Project Lang Stars (total / today) Summary
HKUDS/DeepTutor Python 50,224 DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. AI-powered educational platform with personalization. (+1,930 stars today)
milind-soni/OpenMausBot TypeScript 1,199 Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use.
harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo Python 136,318 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Automated video generation from topics.
hugohe3/ppt-master Python 70,870 AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations.
ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis Python 67,271 LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送。Multi-market AI stock analysis.

🧠 LLMs / Training

Project Lang Stars (total / today) Summary
morluto/rea TypeScript 408,113 Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries. Massive star growth indicates strong interest.
affaan-m/ECC JavaScript 292,746 The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor.
NousResearch/hermes-agent Python 258,533 The agent that grows with you. Nous Research's agent framework.
jingyaogong/minimind Python 64,618 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h! Educational demo of efficient LLM training.
open-compass/opencompass Python 7,557 OpenCompass is an LLM evaluation platform, supporting 100+ datasets covering knowledge, reasoning, coding, science.

🔍 RAG / Knowledge

Project Lang Stars (total / today) Summary
thedotmack/claude-mem TypeScript 104,854 Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures sessions, compresses with AI, injects relevant context.
Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm JavaScript 67,717 Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with EverythingLLM. Everything for powerful local-first agent experience.
meilisearch/meilisearch Rust 59,713 A lightning-fast search engine API bringing AI-powered hybrid search to sites and applications.
run-llama/llama_index Python 52,736 LlamaIndex is the document processing platform for AI. The standard for RAG pipeline construction.
milvus-io/milvus Go 46,529 Milvus is a high-performance, cloud-native vector database built for scalable vector ANN search.
qdrant/qdrant Rust 35,319 Qdrant - High-performance, massive-scale Vector Database and Vector Search Engine for next-gen AI.
mem0ai/mem0 Python 68,066 The Memory Layer for AI Agents - Drop-in memory infrastructure for AI agents and apps.
infiniflow/ragflow Go 93,119 RAGFlow is a leading open-source RAG engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities.
unclecode/crawl4ai Python 86,550 Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown.

3. Trend Signal Analysis

The October 30, 2026 trending data reveals three distinct acceleration patterns in the AI open-source ecosystem:

Agentic Infrastructure Maturation: The most explosive growth is occurring in agent development frameworks that move beyond simple prompt chaining. Projects like obra/superpowers (agentic skills framework) and pbakaus/impeccable (coding agent design vocabulary) represent a new wave of tooling focused on how agents should be structured, not just what they can do. This suggests the community is moving from "can we build agents?" to "how do we build good agents?"

Persistent Memory Becomes Core: The massive star accumulation on claude-mem (104K stars) and mem0 (68K stars) underscores that contextual memory is now recognized as essential infrastructure. Today's developers expect agents to remember across sessions—this is no longer a nice-to-have but a baseline requirement.

Local-First Desktop Agents: The emergence of nightly-labs/openbot and CopilotKit/OpenBot signals a trend toward persistent desktop AI teammates with dedicated resources. This contrasts with ephemeral cloud-based agent sessions and points toward a future where developers work alongside persistent AI colleagues.

The Rust ecosystem is gaining traction in AI infrastructure (qdrant, lancedb, oh-my-pi), indicating performance-critical components are increasingly being rebuilt in memory-safe languages.

4. Community Hot Spots

  • HKUDS/DeepTutor — +1,930 stars today. Lifelong personalized tutoring at scale. The highest-gaining repo today; watch for replication in other vertical AI applications.

  • CopilotKit/OpenBot — Desktop AI coworkers with individual browsers and file access. The AG-UI protocol enabler; likely to become a standard for agentic UI development.

  • nightly-labs/openbot — Local-first persistent AI teammates. Bridges the gap between ephemeral cloud agents and permanent desktop companions.

  • thedotmack/claude-mem — 104K stars and climbing. The definitive solution for persistent agent context. Essential infrastructure for any serious agentic application.

  • obra/superpowers — +1,034 stars. Agentic skills framework representing a methodological shift toward structured agent behavior engineering rather than prompt engineering.

  • qdrant/qdrant — Rust-based vector database gaining steady enterprise adoption. The Rust vector DB trend suggests performance-optimized retrieval will dominate production RAG systems.

item.content:encoded:
Hacker News AI 社区动态日报 2026-10-30

数据来源: Hacker News | 共 30 条 | 生成时间: 2026-10-30 02:07 UTC

The user wants me to translate the entire Hacker News AI Community Digest from English to Chinese. I need to:

  1. Translate all headings, body text, and content
  2. Keep all Markdown structure (tables, lists, headings, etc.)
  3. Keep URLs, project names, technical terms, and identifiers as-is
  4. Use natural technical Chinese register (like a Chinese developer newsletter)
  5. Output ONLY the translation, no preamble or explanation

Let me go through the content carefully and translate it properly while maintaining the structure.

The content has:

  • Main heading with date
  • Section 1: Today's Highlights
  • Section 2: Top News & Discussions with subsections (Models & Research, Tools & Engineering, Industry News, Opinions & Debates)
  • Tables with translations
  • Section 3: Community Sentiment Signal
  • Section 4: Worth Deep Reading (list of 3 items with links)

I'll translate each section, keeping the markdown structure intact.

Hacker News AI 社区摘要

日期： 2026-10-30

1. 今日要闻

今天的 HN AI 动态主要由两大主题主导：Mistral Large 4 以开放权重发布（整体排名第 2），以及围绕 Google Gemini 4 Carbon 声称登顶基准测试的激烈讨论。社区情绪喜忧参半——对模型能力的兴奋被对基准测试可靠性的质疑所抵消（参见"僵尸统计"），而且围绕 AI 智能体系统的隐私担忧也日益加剧（特别是 Claude Code transcript 分享的曝光）。开放权重模型的发布仍是热门话题，而"补丁差距"漏洞论文则为开放权重讨论增添了安全维度。

2. 热门新闻与讨论

🔬 模型与研究

标题 评分 评论 摘要
我们发布 Mistral Large 4 的权重 · HN 1212 340 Mistral 以开放许可证发布其旗舰模型 Large 4 的权重，延续了前沿 AI 公司拥抱开放权重策略的趋势。社区将其视为可访问性的胜利，尽管有人质疑其与完全开源替代方案的實際效用。
Gemini 4 Carbon 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 上排名第一 · HN 328 240 Google 的 Gemini 4 Carbon 在 Artificial Analysis 基准上占据首位，引发关于基准可靠性及 Google AI 快速改进轨迹的讨论。许多评论者对基准测试泛滥表示质疑。
Gemini 4 Carbon · HN 1001 796 Gemini 4 Carbon 正式发布，能力显著提升。高互动量反映了社区对 Google 旗舰模型的强烈关注；讨论中混合着技术分析和对其声称基准测试的质疑。
开放权重 AI 模型可利用补丁差距 · HN 10 8 研究揭示开放权重模型存在"补丁差距"漏洞，恶意行为者可通过权重修改注入后门。互动量低表明这是一项尚未引起广泛关注的早期安全顾虑。
Sleep 框架：LLM 在持续学习中保留知识的新方法 · HN 78 6 Google Research 提出一种受生物学启发的"睡眠"机制，用于对抗 LLM 在持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。技术读者认为该方法有趣，但实际适用性仍不明朗。

🛠️ 工具与工程

标题 评分 评论 摘要
Claude Code 定期将每个后台智能体的 transcript 发送给其模型 · HN 561 225 技术深度分析揭示 Claude Code 向模型发送后台智能体的 transcript，引发严重的隐私担忧。社区反应强烈，许多人质疑数据处理实践以及这是否适用于企业部署。
Dayjob: Tax – 在 50 个专业税务任务上评估 AI 智能体 · HN 253 172 SurgeHQ 发布了一个用于在真实税务准备任务上评估 AI 智能体的基准。这代表了对特定领域智能体评估日益成熟的趋势；评论者讨论了自动化专业服务的难度。
Agent SDK · HN 141 132 Cursor 宣布其 Agent SDK，将其定位为构建 AI 智能体的新标准。讨论聚焦于开发者体验，以及它与 LangChain 和 AutoGen 等现有框架的比较。
Grace Blackwell 需要新的调度器：相同机架可多用 27% 的 GPU · HN 129 21 SkyPilot 提出一种新的 GPU 调度方法，声称可提升 27% 的利用率。对运行大规模 AI 训练的团队很有实用价值；评论量低表明这是小众但有价值的技术内容。

🏢 行业动态

标题 评分 评论 摘要
Google 市值暴跌 5000 亿美元，AI 恐惧震动华尔街 · HN 34 9 Google 在更广泛的科技市场 AI 不确定性中损失 5000 亿美元市值。HN 互动量相对较低，表明该新闻在其他渠道被追踪；讨论聚焦于这是否反映真正的 AI 担忧还是市场过度反应。
Proton 全力投入 AI 使用 · HN 77 71 Proton（注重隐私的公司）宣布将 AI 大规模整合到其产品套件中。社区就这是否符合 Proton 的隐私优先使命展开辩论，对 AI 与隐私的权衡存在分歧。
一家国防承包商让他们的 AI 智能体访问了五角大楼的安全系统 · HN 19 6 有关国防承包商授予 AI 智能体访问五角大楼系统权限的报道引发安全担忧。互动量低，但作为敏感环境中 AI 智能体安全问题的早期预警值得关注。

💬 观点与辩论

标题 评分 评论 摘要
LLM 声音 · HN 346 180 Martin Fowler 分析 LLM 如何形成独特的"声音"和写作风格。引发关于 AI 创造力、作者身份以及 LLM 输出是否真正具有"声音"的深思熟虑的讨论。
僵尸统计：AI 引用的数字从何而来 · HN 144 63 调查 AI discourse 中反复引用的不可靠统计数据，揭示许多数字在未经核实的情况下被反复引用。社区成员分享例子，讨论 AI 新闻中错误信息的挑战。
我用 AI 伪造了一篇学术论文。事情是这样的 · HN 47 26 一位记者记录了使用 AI 生成虚假学术论文并提交给期刊的实验。引发关于同行评审完整性、出版门槛以及 AI 在学术出版中作用的辩论。
AI 让我无家可归 · HN 13 8 关于因 AI 自动化导致失业的个人叙述。虽然评分不高，但代表了 AI 讨论中持续存在的人道影响叙事。

3. 社区情绪信号

今天的 HN AI 讨论揭示了一个与信任疲劳搏斗的社区。高互动量话题聚集在两极：模型能力公告（Mistral、Gemini）引发兴奋但也带来对基准测试的质疑，以及隐私/安全问题（Claude Code transcript 分享、五角大楼智能体访问）引发强烈警觉。

"僵尸统计" 故事引起强烈共鸣——许多评论者表达了对 AI 新闻中反复引用未经核实数据的挫败感。这与对基准测试公告的质疑相呼应，社区越来越质疑顶级排名是否反映了真正的能力提升。

与近期的周期相比，有一个明显的转向围绕智能体导向讨论——不仅仅是模型，而是 AI 系统如何代表用户行动。Claude Code 隐私曝光代表了对智能体 AI 固有数据暴露风险日益增长的担忧。与此同时，Google 市值下跌表明社区正在密切关注商业层面，有人看到 AI 投资疲劳的端倪。

总体情绪：对能力持谨慎乐观态度，越来越多地警惕隐私/安全隐患，并对基准驱动叙事日益质疑。

4. 深度阅读推荐

  1. 僵尸统计：AI 引用的数字从何而来 — 任何消费 AI 新闻的人的必读之作。这项调查揭示了不可靠的统计数据如何在 AI discourse 中不受控制地传播。对于培养批判性信息素养至关重要。

  2. Claude Code 定期将每个后台智能体的 transcript 发送给其模型 — 构建智能体 AI 系统的开发者的关键安全和隐私读物。这一发现对使用处理敏感数据的 AI 智能体的任何人都有影响。

  3. Dayjob: Tax – 在 50 个专业税务任务上评估 AI 智能体 — 代表了使用真实专业任务进行智能体评估的成熟方法。对从事特定领域 AI 智能体研究人员和开发者很有价值。

item.content:encoded:
Hacker News AI Community Digest 2026-10-30

Source: Hacker News | 30 stories | Generated: 2026-10-30 02:07 UTC

Let me analyze this HN feed data and organize it into the requested format.

Looking at the 30 items, I need to categorize them:

Models & Research:

  1. We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4
  2. Gemini 4 Carbon is the new #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5
  3. Gemini 4 Carbon
  4. AI Contributions to GHC
  5. Scaling Hierarchical Networks
  6. Sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
  7. Three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science, and physics
  8. Open-weight AI models can exploit the patch gap

Tools & Engineering: 2. We ran AI agent swarms in Minecraft and Mindustry 3. Show HN: I Turned DOOM into a Transformer 6. Launch HN: Simantic (YC F26) – Firmware Simulation for AI Agents 8. Grace Blackwell needs a new scheduler: 27% more usable GPUs from the same racks 9. Claude Duet is the first personal-assistant-type harness that feels useful 16. Dayjob: Tax – evaluating AI agents on 50 professional tax assignments 18. Claude Code regularly sends each background agent's transcript to its model 20. Show HN: phpClaw – AI agent runtime for PHP with tools, memory and guards 24. The Agent SDK

Industry News: 10. Google value plunges by $500B as AI fears rattle Wall Street 12. Leak Exposes 41,000 Homeland Security Workers–Including Undercover ICE Agents (not AI, skip) 13. Proton goes all in on using AI 28. Apple bullied flash memory suppliers, and why AI datacenters changed the game

  1. A Defense Contractor Gave Their AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System

Opinions & Debates: 4. LLM Voice 5. IgE disruptor for food allergy with Claude-enabled antibody design (somewhat research) 7. Zombie stats: Where the numbers AI quotes come from 19. AI, Lean, and the Future of Formal Verification, with Lean Creator Leo de Moura 21. I Used AI to Fake a Scientific Paper. Here's What Happened 26. Building an AI-native engineering org 27. AI Made Me Homeless 30. Survival LLM: AI assistant and emergency library

Now I'll organize these into the final format with the highest-scoring items from each category.

Top performers by engagement:

  1. Mistral Large 4 (1212 points, 340 comments) - major model announcement
  2. Gemini 4 Carbon - #1 on benchmarks (1001 points, 796 comments)
  3. Three new discoveries (1154 points, 702 comments)
  4. Claude Code privacy concerns (561 points, 225 comments)
  5. Survival LLM (538 points, 202 comments)

Other notable mentions include LLM Voice (346 comments), Dayjob Tax (253 comments), and Zombie stats (144 comments). Now I'll structure the digest.

Hacker News AI Community Digest

Date: 2026-10-30

1. Today's Highlights

Today's HN AI feed is dominated by two major themes: the release of Mistral Large 4 as open weights (the #2 story overall), and intense discussion around Google's Gemini 4 Carbon claiming the top spot on benchmarks. Community sentiment is mixed—excitement about model capabilities is tempered by skepticism about benchmark reliability (see "Zombie stats") and growing privacy concerns around AI agent systems (notably the Claude Code transcript sharing revelation). The release of open-weight models continues to be a hot topic, with the "patch gap" vulnerability paper adding a security dimension to the open-weights discussion.

2. Top News & Discussions

🔬 Models & Research

Title Score Comments Summary
We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4 · HN 1212 340 Mistral releases the weights of their flagship Large 4 model under an open license, continuing the trend of frontier AI companies embracing open-weight strategies. The community celebrates this as a win for accessibility, though some debate the actual utility vs. fully open alternatives.
Gemini 4 Carbon is the new #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 · HN 328 240 Google's Gemini 4 Carbon claims the top position on the Artificial Analysis benchmark, sparking discussion about benchmark reliability and Google AI's rapid improvement trajectory. Many commenters express skepticism about benchmark proliferation.
Gemini 4 Carbon · HN 1001 796 Official announcement of Gemini 4 Carbon with significant capability improvements. The high engagement reflects strong community interest in Google's flagship model; discussions mix technical analysis with skepticism about claimed benchmarks.
Open-weight AI models can exploit the patch gap · HN 10 8 Research reveals that open-weight models can be vulnerable to a "patch gap" exploit where malicious actors can inject backdoors via weight modifications. The low engagement suggests this is an early-stage security concern not yet widely noticed.
Sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning · HN 78 6 Google Research proposes a biological-inspired "sleep" mechanism for LLMs to combat catastrophic forgetting in continual learning settings. Technical readers find the approach interesting though practical applicability remains unclear.

🛠️ Tools & Engineering

Title Score Comments Summary
Claude Code regularly sends each background agent's transcript to its model · HN 561 225 A technical deep-dive reveals that Claude Code sends background agent transcripts to the model, raising significant privacy concerns. The community reacts with alarm, with many questioning data handling practices and whether this applies to enterprise deployments.
Dayjob: Tax – evaluating AI agents on 50 professional tax assignments · HN 253 172 SurgeHQ releases a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on real-world tax preparation tasks. This represents a growing trend toward domain-specific agent evaluation; commenters discuss the difficulty of automating professional services.
The Agent SDK · HN 141 132 Cursor announces their Agent SDK, positioning it as a new standard for building AI agents. The discussion centers on developer experience and how it compares to existing frameworks like LangChain and AutoGen.
Grace Blackwell needs a new scheduler: 27% more usable GPUs from the same racks · HN 129 21 SkyPilot proposes a new GPU scheduling approach that claims 27% better utilization. Practical for teams running large-scale AI training; the low comment count suggests niche but valuable technical content.

🏢 Industry News

Title Score Comments Summary
Google value plunges by $500B as AI fears rattle Wall Street · HN 34 9 Google loses $500B in market value amid broader AI uncertainty in tech markets. The relatively low HN engagement suggests the story is being tracked elsewhere; discussion focuses on whether this reflects genuine AI concerns or market overreaction.
Proton goes all in on using AI · HN 77 71 Proton (privacy-focused company) announces major AI integration into their product suite. The community debates whether this aligns with Proton's privacy-first mission, with divided opinions on AI and privacy tradeoffs.
A Defense Contractor Gave Their AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System · HN 19 6 Report of a defense contractor granting an AI agent access to Pentagon systems raises security concerns. Low engagement but notable as an early warning sign about AI agent security in sensitive environments.

💬 Opinions & Debates

Title Score Comments Summary
LLM Voice · HN 346 180 Martin Fowler's analysis of how LLMs are developing distinctive "voices" and writing styles. Generates thoughtful discussion about AI creativity, authorship, and whether LLM output can genuinely have a "voice."
Zombie stats: Where the numbers AI quotes come from · HN 144 63 Investigation into dubious statistics frequently quoted in AI discourse reveals many numbers are repeatedly cited without verification. Community members share examples and discuss the challenge of misinformation in AI news.
I Used AI to Fake a Scientific Paper. Here's What Happened · HN 47 26 A journalist documents their experiment using AI to generate a fake scientific paper and submit it to journals. Sparks debate about peer review integrity, publication gatekeeping, and the role of AI in scientific publishing.
AI Made Me Homeless · HN 13 8 A personal account of job displacement due to AI automation. While not high-scoring, it represents the human impact narrative that persists in AI discussions.

3. Community Sentiment Signal

Today's HN AI discussion reveals a community grappling with trust fatigue. High-engagement topics cluster around two poles: model capability announcements (Mistral, Gemini) generating excitement but also skepticism about benchmarks, and privacy/security concerns (Claude Code transcript sharing, Pentagon agent access) triggering significant alarm.

The "Zombie stats" story resonates strongly—many commenters express frustration with repeated citation of dubious AI statistics without verification. This dovetails with skepticism toward benchmark announcements, where the community increasingly questions whether top rankings reflect genuine capability improvements.

Compared to recent cycles, there's a noticeable shift toward agent-focused discussion—not just models, but how AI systems act on users' behalf. The Claude Code privacy revelation represents a growing concern about the data exposure risks inherent in agentic AI. Meanwhile, the Google market value drop suggests the community is watching the business dimension closely, with some seeing AI investment fatigue setting in.

Overall sentiment: cautiously optimistic on capabilities, increasingly wary of privacy/security implications, and growing skeptical of benchmark-driven narratives.

4. Worth Deep Reading

  1. Zombie stats: Where the numbers AI quotes come from — Essential reading for anyone consuming AI news. This investigation reveals how dubious statistics propagate through the AI discourse unchecked. Important for developing critical information hygiene.

  2. Claude Code regularly sends each background agent's transcript to its model — Critical security and privacy read for developers building agentic AI systems. The revelation has implications for anyone using AI agents with sensitive data.

  3. Dayjob: Tax – evaluating AI agents on 50 professional tax assignments — Represents a maturing approach to agent evaluation with real-world professional tasks. Valuable for researchers and developers working on domain-specific AI agents.

This digest is auto-generated by agents-radar.

item.content:encoded:
ArXiv AI 研究日报 2026-10-30

数据来源: ArXiv (cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.LG) | 共 38 篇论文 | 生成时间: 2026-10-30 02:07 UTC

The user wants me to translate this entire ArXiv AI Research Digest into Chinese. I need to:

  1. Translate all headings
  2. Translate all body text
  3. Keep all markdown structure (tables, lists, headings, horizontal rules, etc.)
  4. Keep URLs, arxiv IDs, numbers, and technical terms as-is
  5. Use natural technical Chinese - not literal word-for-word

Let me go through this carefully:

1. Today's Highlights

2. Key Papers

🧠 Large Language Models

🤖 Agents & Reasoning

🔧 Methods & Frameworks

📊 Applications

3. Research Trend Signal

4. Worth Deep Reading

Then the tables with paper info.

Let me translate this properly in technical Chinese register:

ArXiv AI 研究文摘 — 2026年10月30日

1. 今日要闻

今日 ArXiv 提交的研究揭示了几个重要的方向。首先，多智能体系统受到广泛关注，新研究揭示了临床 LLM 团队中的公平性漏洞，以及针对智能体记忆归因的新型攻击向量。其次，强化学习持续取得进展，包括在混淆和后果驱动策略学习下的新型离线 RL 方法，解决动态一致性问题。第三，LLM 效率仍是关键主题，无损 KV 缓存压缩的创新使得个人设备推理成为可能。最后，基准测试开发在各个领域蓬勃发展——机器人、代码编辑、逆合成和金融建议都有新的评估框架。

2. 重点论文

🧠 大语言模型

论文 作者 摘要
Keepace.ai: A Technical Report on a Large Language Model for Sports and Health Keepace.ai Team, et al. 推出基于 Qwen3.5-27B 构建的领域专用 LLM，用于体育健康指导，解决该领域缺乏精选训练语料和评估基准的问题。
GAAC: Lossless KV Compression for Bandwidth-Efficient LLM Inference on Personal Devices Yipin Guo, et al. 提出 Group-Adaptive Additive Codec，一种无损 KV 缓存压缩方法，针对内存受限的个人设备长上下文推理场景。
Component Translation and Judge-Labelled Refusal: A Multilingual Safety Evaluation Yongxi Zhou, et al. 引入配对反转评估方法，通过逐组件翻译比较来评估 LLM 的多语言安全性和拒绝行为。
Rubricon: Automated Rubric Generation and Refinement for LLM Evaluation and Training Ulyana Tkachenko, et al. 提出无需人类偏好标签生成判别性评分标准的流程，可在无标准答案的任务中实现奖励分配。

🤖 智能体与推理

论文 作者 摘要
Precedent or Intent? What Coding Agents Follow When Evolving Existing Code Haichao Zhu, et al. 研究编码智能体在平衡过往实现决策与新任务指令时的行为，为智能体化软件演进提出根本性问题。
Is it my preference? Role Grounding Attack against Agent's Memory via Social Interaction Haoran Bu, et al. 发现角色归因错误攻击，恶意行为者可通过社交平台利用智能体记忆系统改变偏好归因。
Disparity Laundering: Consensus Without Fairness in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems Xiaoyang Wang, et al. 证明临床 LLM 多智能体团队的 deliberative 过程不会平均化偏见，揭示各模型家族和聚合拓扑上的系统性公平性失败。
Skeleton Coding: Program Structure as a Specification for Agents Aditya Golatkar, et al. 主张使用程序结构作为行为规范，减少开发者必须为智能体提供的显式规范数量。
DecompGym: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Designing Decomposition Algorithms Sikai Cheng, et al. 引入 LLM 智能体设计 Benders 分解和列生成算法的基准，针对硬优化自动化问题。

🔧 方法与框架

论文 作者 摘要
ParaTTT: Parallelizing Test-Time Training Layers with Deep Memories Noel Loo, et al. 并行化使用非线性神经网络记忆的 TTT 层，在保持可扩展性的同时提升相比线性快速权重的表达能力。
Nearly Minimax Optimal Regret for Adversarial Linear Bandits with Strong Corruptions Qiwei Di, et al. 在强奖励损坏的线性 bandit 中实现近 minimax 最优 regret，解决重要性加权失效的设定。
Variational Consequence-Driven Offline Reinforcement Learning Wen Jiang, et al. 通过强制底层结构解决离线 RL 中的动态一致性问题，超越仅在动作分布上施加散度约束的方法。
Transportable Offline Reinforcement Learning in Presence of Unmeasured Confounding Junyi Liao, et al. 研究分布偏移和未测量混淆下的离线 RL，提出在新领域部署的可迁移性方法。
Two Birds with One Stone: Skill-Augmented Generation via Unified Retrieval and Utilization Zihan Luo, et al. 在单一模型中统一技能检索和利用，通过可重用的外部知识增强 LLM 处理复杂任务的能力。
The Endgame of FSDP Communication: Layout-Aware Collectives Zejian Wang, et al. 通过布局感知的逐参数缓冲区和展平 rank-major 缓冲区之间的转换优化 FSDP2 集合操作，针对拷贝引擎、RDMA 和 NVSwitch。
In-Context Learning for Multi-Fidelity Multiscale Model Closure Xinyuan Li, et al. 应用上下文学习结合粗尺度 PDE 模型和有限细尺度数据，实现高效准确的 PDE 求解。
B2P-Corr: Batch-to-Population Gradient Estimators for Non-Decomposable Correlation Losses Jingquan Yan, et al. 为 PCC 和 CCC 等不可分解相关性度量开发梯度估计器，使数据集级目标的随机优化成为可能。

📊 应用

论文 作者 摘要
A Tutorial on Generative Models for Music Audio Mateusz Modrzejewski, et al. 提供全面的专著，解释音乐音频生成系统背后的方法，面向该领域的新读者。
MEV: A Multi-Event Video Dataset for Long-Take Generation Peiyuan Zhu, et al. 引入多事件长镜头视频生成数据集，解决当前文生视频模型的时间一致性挑战。
Verification-Guided Retrosynthesis: Reaction Feedback and Evidence Timing Hongxuan Shi, et al. 在逆合成搜索中集成可行性验证，防止因不可行反应导致的无效路线。
CuraEval: Evaluating Demonstration Curation on Mixed-Skill Robot Data Jiuyi Xu, et al. 评估从不同技能水平操作员中选择机器人模仿学习演示的方法。
Embodied at Sea: Imitation Learning for Multi-Task Underwater Manipulation Greta Perez-Haiek, et al. 解决海洋视觉扭曲和动态水流造成的域偏移问题，用于行为克隆。
RainCheck: Harnessing Historical Weather Data with ML for Rainfall Forecasting Shahran Rahman Alve, et al. 批评降雨预报的标准随机训练测试划分，提出正确利用时间依赖的方法。
The Indian Financial Automated Advice Bias (IFAAB) Dataset Kriti Mahajan 引入包含 31,734 个 GPT-4o 生成的金融建议样本的反事实审计数据集，用于检测印度背景下的社会经济差异。
Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification Debargha Ganguly, et al. 推出 EasyProver，使用隔离上下文的递归智能体实现 669/672 道 PutnamBench 题目和全部六道 IMO 题目。

3. 研究趋势信号

今日提交的研究指向几个新兴方向。多智能体公平性与安全日益受到关注——近期工作证明 LLM 团队 deliberative 过程会放大而非减轻偏见，智能体记忆系统的新型攻击面正在被识别。个人设备部署的 LLM 效率正在加速，无损 KV 缓存压缩和布局感知的分布式训练优化持续推进。基准测试激增覆盖专业领域（金融建议、机器人、化学、定理证明），反映领域成熟度。分布偏移下的离线 RL 正在获得关注，特别是解决未测量混淆和动态一致性的方法。最后，技能增强和程序引导的智能体代表向结构化规范和外部知识集成的转变，而非端到端行为学习。

4. 深度阅读推荐

  1. Disparity Laundering: Consensus Without Fairness in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems — 这篇论文从根本上挑战了多智能体 LLM deliberative 过程会平均化错误的假设。通过对五个模型家族和四种聚合拓扑在真实临床病例上的全因子研究，提供了偏见持续存在甚至放大的实证证据。对任何部署临床 AI 系统的人员都是必读之作。

  2. ParaTTT: Parallelizing Test-Time Training Layers with Deep Memories — 测试时训练是在线适应循环架构的一个有前景的范式。本工作解决了非线性记忆层的关键并行化问题，弥补了与 Mamba-2 等线性替代方案之间的表达能力差距。对序列建模和高效适应相关工作具有重要意义。

  3. EasyProver: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving — 在无需额外训练的情况下实现 PutnamBench 和 IMO 问题的接近完美表现，是 LLM 形式化验证的突破。递归智能体和异步搜索中的架构创新值得任何从事数学推理或代码验证工作的人深入研究。

本日报由 agents-radar 自动生成。
